cat > evaluate.sh << 'EOF'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
raw="$1"
good="$2"
bad="$3"
if test -z "$(printf '%s' "$raw" | tr -d '[:space:]')"; then
  echo "UNKNOWN"
elif printf '%s' "$raw" | grep -Eqi -- "$good"; then
  echo "PASS"
elif printf '%s' "$raw" | grep -Eqi -- "$bad"; then
  echo "FAIL"
else
  echo "UNKNOWN"
fi
EOF

cat > collect-endpoint-evidence.sh << 'EOF'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
L="$HOME/lab03"
E="$L/evaluate.sh"
FV="$(fdesetup status)"
SIP="$(csrutil status)"
GK="$(spctl --status)"
MDM="$(profiles status -type enrollment | grep 'MDM enrollment')"
PROF="$(system_profiler SPConfigurationProfileDataType | grep 'askForPassword')"
GAP="$(cat "$L/samples/profiles-status-unknown.txt")"
if test -z "$GAP"; then
  echo "WARN: profile sample query returned nothing" >&2
fi
MV="$("$E" "$MDM" 'MDM enrollment: Yes' 'MDM enrollment: No')"
PV="$("$E" "$PROF" 'askForPassword=1' 'no profiles installed')"
if test "$MV" = "PASS" && test "$PV" = "PASS"; then SL="PASS"; else SL="FAIL"; fi
echo "CONTROL: Encryption at rest (CC6.1) | SUBSYSTEM: FileVault | VERDICT: $("$E" "$FV" 'FileVault is On' 'FileVault is Off') | RAW: $FV"
echo "CONTROL: OS tamper protection (CC6.8) | SUBSYSTEM: SIP | VERDICT: $("$E" "$SIP" 'status: enabled' 'status: disabled') | RAW: $SIP"
echo "CONTROL: Software execution control (CC6.8) | SUBSYSTEM: Gatekeeper | VERDICT: $("$E" "$GK" 'assessments enabled' 'assessments disabled') | RAW: $GK"
echo "CONTROL: Centrally managed (CC1.x) | SUBSYSTEM: MDM | VERDICT: $MV | RAW: $MDM"
echo "CONTROL: Screen-lock policy enforced (CC6.1) | SUBSYSTEM: MDM/profiles | VERDICT: $SL | RAW: $PROF"
echo "CONTROL: Profile query (sample gap) | SUBSYSTEM: MDM/profiles | VERDICT: $("$E" "$GAP" 'ScreenLock' 'no profiles') | RAW: <query returned nothing>"
EOF
